니센(NISSEN, 日泉)은 일본의 자전거 케이블 제조사입니다. 직기에: NISSEN (日泉) is a Japanese bicycle cable maker. Originally a maker of springs for weaving looms, the company moved into bicycle brake wire and has focused on bicycle cables ever since, for nearly 70 years. Now that hardly any companies still make cables in Japan, Nissen continues to produce its inner wires and outer housing at home.
레버를 당길 때의 가벼움, 변속이 딱 맞아떨어지는 순간, 오래 타도 무뎌: A light lever pull, a shift that clicks exactly into place, brakes that stay crisp ride after ride. Everything a rider feels at the fingertips comes from the friction and flexibility of the cable. Nissen is the brand that makes that unseen part as honestly as possible.
70년 가까이 이어온 자전거 케이블 생산: Nearly 70 years of making bicycle cables
일본에서 직접 만드는 이너와 아우터: Inner wire and housing made in Japan
31가닥 워링턴 구조의 SP31 이너 와이어: SP31 inner wire with a 31-strand Warrington construction
코일이 비치는 반투명 컬러 아우터: Translucent colour housing that shows the coil
케이블은 자전거에서 가장 눈에 띄지 않는 부품이지만, 가장 자주 손이 닿: Cables are the least noticeable part of a bicycle, yet the one your hands work most often. Nissen selects stainless steel, twists the strands and finishes the surface to make cables that are flexible and low in friction. Flexible housing reduces friction with the inner wire, making braking and shifting noticeably smoother.
니센의 케이블은 일본의 자전거 브랜드 심웍스(SimWorks)와 함께 만: Nissen cables are also introduced to bike shops and builders around the world through SimWorks by Nissen, a line made together with the Japanese bicycle brand SimWorks.
녹에 강한 스테인리스를 기본으로 합니다. 비와 땀에도 오래도록 처음의 감: Built on rust-resistant stainless steel. It keeps its original feel through rain and sweat for years.
31가닥을 촘촘히 꼬아 둥글고 매끄럽게. 늘어남이 적고, 아우터 속을 부: 31 strands tightly twisted for a round, smooth wire. Low stretch, gliding smoothly inside the housing.
폴리에틸렌 라이너와 유연한 코일. 레버를 당기는 힘이 그대로 브레이크와: A polyethylene liner and a flexible coil. The force of your lever pull goes straight to brakes and derailleurs.
프레임 컬러에 맞춘 아우터 한 줄이 자전거의 인상을 완성합니다. 반투명: A single line of housing matched to your frame completes the look of the bike. The stainless coil shows through the translucent coating.
From inner wire to housing. The easiest way to transform your braking and shifting.

스테인리스 코일이 비치는 반투명 컬러 코팅과 폴리에틸렌 라이너. 16가지: Translucent colour coating over a visible stainless coil, with a polyethylene liner. 16 colours.

1950년대 이탈리아의 유니버설 원형 스틸 아우터를 다시 만든, 메시 패: Mesh-patterned housing reissued from Universal's 1950s Italian round steel housing.
31 strands of stainless steel,
smooth all the way to the lever.
SP31은 니센의 대표 이너 와이어입니다. SUS304 스테인리스를 31: SP31 is Nissen's signature inner wire. SUS304 stainless steel is twisted in a 31-strand Warrington construction, closing the gaps between strands and giving a round cross-section. After precision machining for roundness, the surface is plasma plated to cut friction inside the housing even further.
그 결과는 레버에서 바로 느껴집니다. 브레이크는 더 가볍고 일정하게 당겨: You feel the result at the lever. Brakes pull lighter and more consistently, and shifts land cleanly. Low stretch means your setup stays dialled for longer, another strength of SP31.
녹에 강한 SUS304 스테인리스. 비 오는 날의 라이딩 뒤에도 처음의: Rust-resistant SUS304 stainless. It stays smooth for a long time, even after rainy rides.
굵기가 다른 가닥을 함께 꼬는 워링턴 방식으로 틈을 줄였습니다. 둥근 단: The Warrington method twists strands of different thicknesses together to close the gaps. The round section glides evenly inside the housing.
정밀 가공으로 진원도를 높인 뒤 표면에 플라스마 도금을 더해 마찰을 줄였: Precision machining improves roundness, then plasma plating on the surface reduces friction.

Making the cables of the 1950s
again, today.
클래식 자전거를 복원하거나 그 시대의 분위기로 자전거를 꾸밀 때, 마지막: When restoring a classic bicycle or building one in the spirit of its era, cables are often the last part that is hard to find. Nissen's heritage housing reissues the brake housing used on French and Italian bicycles from the 1950s to the 1970s.
겉모습은 그 시절 그대로, 만드는 방식은 오늘의 니센 그대로. 랜도너와: The look of that era, made the way Nissen makes cables today. Two housings suited to randonneurs, vintage road bikes and classic touring bikes.
1950년부터 1970년 사이 프랑스에서 르네 에르스(René Herse: A reissue of the cable used on bicycles built by René Herse and Alex Singer in France between 1950 and 1970. Housing for French randonneurs and classic touring bikes.
1950년대 이탈리아에서 주로 쓰이던 유니버설(Universal)의 원형: A reissue of Universal's round steel housing, mainly used in Italy in the 1950s. Its mesh-patterned surface suits vintage Italian road bikes.
Choosing the right cable
for your bike.
케이블은 브레이크용과 변속용의 굵기와 구조가 다릅니다. 이너 와이어 굵기: Brake and shift cables differ in diameter and construction. The basic rule is to choose housing that matches the diameter of your inner wire. At Rubi Workshop we choose the right combination for your bike and install it for you.
표의 수치는 대표 사양입니다. 유압 브레이크와 전동 변속에는 쓰이지 않으: Figures shown are typical specifications. These cables are not used with hydraulic brakes or electronic shifting, and the right cable can vary with the type of levers, brakes and derailleurs. Replacement intervals depend on riding conditions, but if your levers start to feel heavy or your shifting drifts, it is time to check your cables.
자전거와 레버, 브레이크와 변속기 종류를 확인하고 맞는 케이블을 고릅니다: We check your bike, levers, brakes and derailleurs, and choose the right cables.
See the housing colours in person and match them to your frame, bar tape and grips.
핸들을 끝까지 돌려도 당기지 않는 길이로, 아우터 끝을 반듯하게 잘라 마: Lengths that never pull even at full steering lock, with housing ends cut square and finished cleanly.
브레이크 간격과 변속을 다시 맞추고, 초기 늘어남 뒤에도 점검해 드립니다: We re-adjust brake clearance and shifting, and check again after the initial stretch.
From loom springs
to bicycle cables:
the Nissen story.
직물을 짜는 기계에 들어가는 스프링을 만들던 니센은 자전거 브레이크 와이: Nissen began by making springs for weaving looms, moved into bicycle brake wire, and has made bicycle cables for nearly 70 years since. Even now that much production has moved overseas, Nissen is one of the few companies still making cables in Japan.
Nissen begins by making springs for weaving looms.
스프링으로 쌓은 금속 가공 기술로 자전거 브레이크 와이어를 만들기 시작합: Building on its metalworking skill with springs, Nissen begins making bicycle brake wire.
70년 가까이 자전거 케이블을 만들며, 일본에서 직접 생산하는 몇 안 되: Making bicycle cables for nearly 70 years, Nissen remains one of the few cable makers still producing in Japan.
